authority.tenantAuthority: A topic or channel identifier is never authority; the server derives tenant and subject ownership from trusted authentication context plus current tenant state.
authority.subjectAuthority: The authenticated subject and current membership determine who may publish or consume an event.
authority.outboxAuthority: Committed domain changes emit an outbox row in the same transaction; the outbox row is downstream durable evidence, not the business truth.
authority.deliveryAuthority: Private Realtime and NATS consumers are progressive delivery mechanisms only.

rules: eventId and payloadDigest are opaque digests, not authorization proof.
organizationId, subjectId, actorId, resourceType and resourceId are server-derived from trusted context, not browser input.
topic follows scope:tenant-or-resource-id:purpose and is only a routing candidate.
safePayload contains allowlisted IDs, versions, job state and safe display metadata only.
No body, prompt, token, secret, raw provider output, unbounded PII or cross-tenant identifier may appear in the envelope or payload.

matrix.ownership: current ACTIVE membership for the tenant
current ACTIVE membership for the tenant
current ACTIVE membership for the resource owner
current ACTIVE membership for the tenant
current ACTIVE membership for the resource owner
current ACTIVE membership for the tenant

rules: The server chooses scope, tenant/resource identifier and purpose from current ownership facts and event type.
Clients may not invent a scope or purpose outside this matrix.
The identifier alone never grants access or publish rights.

topicVocabulary.ownership: The owner id encoded in the topic is derived from current server-authorized tenant or resource identity and current ACTIVE membership; guessing it never grants access.

ownership.subjectRule: Only the current ACTIVE membership for the authenticated subject may authorize publish or consume rights.
ownership.resourceRule: A guessed subjectId, membershipId, organizationId or resourceId never grants access by itself.
ownership.crossTenantRule: Cross-tenant or unowned subject guesses fail closed.

lease.claim: bounded row lease owned by one publisher at a time
lease.expiry: lease expiry makes the row reclaimable
lease.reclaim: expired or failed claims may be retried until bounded attempts are exhausted

rules: Business row and outbox row are committed in one transaction.
Claims use bounded locking or lease semantics and are idempotent.
Duplicate publish attempts never create a second logical effect.
A terminal failure is visible and never silently dropped.

idempotency.requestKey: A publish or job submission carries one opaque idempotency key digest scoped to organizationId, topic and operation.
idempotency.sameRequest: A retried request with the same fingerprint reuses the original terminal receipt without creating another outbox row.
idempotency.differentRequest: A reused key with a different fingerprint fails closed with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.
idempotency.retention: Reuse safety after expiry is a future persistence policy; the contract does not promise it.

rules: All string values are printable and length-bounded.
Safe display metadata may summarize state only.

limitations: This contract defines no migration, producer implementation, worker code, browser UI, provider call or hosted behavior.
Private Realtime and NATS delivery remain downstream implementation and evidence work.
M3-DB01 owns migration/index/policy DDL; M3-T02/T03/T04/T05 own runtime consumers.
